== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Power Harpoon (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Power Harpoon (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]]. The whole of the disc card and the whole of the 2018 E card, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>b4a593fc1058df188eed659981fff1218e045176</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
